prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1335; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle was stationary when contacted by a third-party vehicle reversing from a space. Photos of both vehicles received from the insured. Liability appears clear on the facts reported. Third-party carrier notified and acknowledged coverage.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel, who has requested that all communication be directed to their office. Letter of representation received and logged. Claimant reports lower back strain following the impact and states treatment is ongoing. Medical authorization requested through counsel.

Entry 3: Counsel's office provided initial treatment records from the urgent care visit. Diagnosis listed as acute lumbar strain with recommended physical therapy. No fractures or imaging findings noted in the records received so far. Follow-up records requested from the treating provider.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspection completed at the repair facility. Rear bumper cover, tail lamp assembly, and trunk panel damage confirmed consistent with the reported impact. Repair estimate received and under review. Counsel notified that the property damage evaluation is in progress.

Entry 5: Physical therapy progress notes received through counsel showing improving range of motion over the course of treatment. Bodily injury evaluation placed on hold pending the treating provider's discharge summary. Reserves reviewed and adjusted. File diary set for follow-up with counsel's office.
